comment: Prompt bank for the semantic stage. Several prompts per class keep a label from depending on one phrasing. Bump 'version' on any edit: it is part of the cache fingerprint.

personal_people: a personal family photograph with people
a candid photograph of friends or relatives
a snapshot of people together at home or outdoors
family_home: a photograph taken inside a family home
an everyday domestic scene photographed by a family member
portrait: a portrait photograph of one person
a close-up photograph of somebody's face
landscape: a photograph of mountains, forest, sea or fields
city_travel: a travel photograph of a city street or landmark
a holiday photograph taken while travelling
event: a photograph from a celebration such as a birthday or wedding
a photograph of people at a party or ceremony
pet: a photograph of a pet dog or cat
a photograph of a domestic animal at home
artistic_photo: an artistic photograph with deliberate composition
screenshot: a screenshot from a mobile phone application
a captured phone screen with user interface elements
a screenshot of a desktop computer window
document: a photograph or scan of a printed document
a photographed sheet of paper with printed text
receipt_invoice: a photo of a receipt, bill, or invoice
a photographed paper receipt with prices and totals
book_page: a photograph of a page of a book
a photographed page of printed text from a book or magazine
label_packaging: a photograph of a product label or packaging
a close-up photograph of a barcode or an ingredients list
product_reference: a reference photograph of a product taken for shopping purposes
a photograph of an object taken to remember a model or price
whiteboard_notes: a photograph of a whiteboard with handwritten notes
a photograph of handwritten notes on paper
low_information: a blurry accidental photograph with no clear subject
an almost empty photograph of a wall, floor or dark frame
other: a photograph that does not fit any other category

negative: a photograph taken with a camera
a screenshot of a computer or phone screen
